Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change can affect toolpaths and posted G-code.

What passed:

- The PR merges with upstream main `1d3d935418e36e7618985c8cb9217657ece32cd1` without conflicts.
- The local test build passed for `camcraft-motion` and `camcraft-app`.
- `contour_whole`: 4 passed. `contour_whole_step`: 3 passed. `real_tip_contour`: 4 passed.
- The quick gate completed 189 steps: 188 passed, 1 failed. Test totals: 2263 passed, 1 failed, 62 ignored.
- The failed test was `shoulder_adaptive::containment_outside_clears_past_the_edge_never_the_recess`. It exceeded its 60-second limit during the suite. The isolated repeat passed in 52.30 seconds.

The initial timing failure was:

```text
crates/app/tests/shoulder_adaptive.rs:88:5:
the band plans in seconds, not minutes
```

Clippy passed for both touched crates, with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.

I repeated two mutations from the PR body:

- Remove `check_unread`: the vertical-sliver test failed. Restore the call: the test passed.
- Pass `&lad` instead of `&trimmed` to `emit_band`: the two-island test failed. It measured 194.130 mm instead of one lap of about 97 mm. Restore the argument: all 4 contour tests passed.

Requested before merge:

1. **Check each stopped-hole level, including index zero.** See [`crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs:116`](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/4605573a32b92d74afc528ddba2bcd5a6e655fbd/crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs#L116). `first_split` checks only the earliest hole stop. It also excludes index zero. Thus a valid lower bore can be omitted while the generator returns `Ok`.

   I confirmed two cases with temporary local tests:

   - Use the PR's `counterbore_part` fixture with `params(20.0, 0.0, 12.0)`. The shoulder is at Z 10. The first cut level is Z 8. The lower bore has no passes at Z 8 or Z 0. The note incorrectly says that the part is solid below Z 10.
   - Use that counterbore beside a second body with a blind hole. Set the blind floor to Z 14 and the stepdown to 4 mm. The blind hole stops before Z 12. This stop hides the counterbore change at Z 8. The lower counterbore again has no passes.

   Check all candidate hole-stop levels before the outer stop. Include a hole that changes before the first cut level. Continue the lower bore, or refuse it with the failed level. Add tests for both cases. Both local tests failed on the restored PR code.

Notes:

- No NC or CL goldens changed. There were no moved golden lines to compare.
- The existing large source files grew. `contour.rs` now has 514 lines; `generate.rs` has 3847. A later split can reduce their size.
- No UI files changed. Before/after UI screenshots are not required.
- All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2460`. No GitHub runner was used.
- All temporary test and mutation changes were restored. No review evidence was committed or pushed.
- The batch and release gates were not run. The full quick gate was not repeated after the isolated timing test passed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Check every stopped-hole level before the outer stop, including index zero.

- The split search now checks sorted, distinct hole-stop levels. `counterbore_changing_before_first_cut_level_keeps_lower_bore` pins full lower-bore laps at Z8 and Z0 when the first stepdown crosses the shoulder.
- An earlier blind-hole stop no longer hides a later counterbore change. `earlier_blind_hole_stop_does_not_hide_later_counterbore_change` pins the upper and lower bore laps through Bottom Z.

Both pins failed on the reviewed code. Excluding index zero made the first pin fail. Checking only the earliest stop made the second pin fail. Restoring the fix passed all six contour tests.

Clippy passed for motion and app, all targets, with warnings denied. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed 185/186 steps. Its only failure was the same shoulder timing assertion noted in the review. The exact isolated repeat passed in 57.13 seconds. The full gate remains red.

**Verdict: blockers**

Independent second review (Opus, safety floor). Read from the diff at `c6b66a532`. Not built.

## Gouge check

I found no gouge path. Each band walks only the rings that `contour_depth::ladder` proves legal against the material above each level (section and shadow). An upper, smaller ring stops where a lower, larger outline starts. It is never cut at that lower level. A lower band starts only at `remaining[j]` and below, so a lower, larger outline is never cut at an upper level. The failure mode that stays is stock left behind. The blocker below is of that type.

## Blocker

1. **The first band discards its floor passes when the split is at index zero.** See `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs:258-262`. In the arm `Some(0) if band_idx == 0`, the code replaces the region and emits nothing from the first band. But `ladder` can give a ring a floor level between Top Z and the first flat level (`contour_depth.rs:264-293`, the #2004 floor search). That floor pass is lost, and its `ring_notes` are lost too. The result is `Ok` with no note.
   - Example A: `two_islands_part()` with `params(15.0, 0.0, 12.0)`. The levels are Z 3 and Z 0. The ring of Island A is not legal at Z 3, and its floor is Z 10. `outer_stop` is `Some(0)`, so the fallback slices the plate at Z 3. The wall of Island A (Z 10..15) is never cut.
   - Example B: the PR's own pin `counterbore_changing_before_first_cut_level_keeps_lower_bore` (`params(20.0, 0.0, 12.0)`). The upper bore ring gets the floor Z 10. The fallback drops it. The pin asserts only Z 8 and Z 0, so it does not see that the upper bore wall (Z 10..20) has no pass.
   - On `main`, this case walked the upper ring at its floor and missed the lower outline. With this PR it walks the lower outline and misses the upper wall. It is still a silently partial path, which is the defect of #2436. Any whole-model Contour with a stepdown larger than the height of a boss or a counterbore step above the first level shows it.
   - Recommended fix: in the band-0 `Some(0)` arm, do the same as the `Some(j)` arm. Trim the ladder at `remaining[0]`. If the trimmed ladder is not empty, forward the notes, emit it, push the region to `walked`, and set `ceiling`. Then slice the next region. Add pins that assert a full lap of the upper ring at its floor: Island A at Z 10 in example A, and the upper bore (extent 12) at Z 10 in example B.

## Non-blocking findings

- `contour_whole.rs:78` and `contour_whole.rs:186` classify errors by substring (`"open"`, `"hole"`, `"farther than"`, `"no contour ring"`). A change of wording elsewhere changes the error class or the deferral. A typed variant is safer. Follow-up `P7`.
- `first_split` (`contour_whole.rs:120-135`) compares hole counts after the tool offset. A lower bore that is smaller than the tool closes in the offset. Then there is no split, and the ring note says that the part is solid below. The tool cannot cut that bore, so this leaves no wrong motion. But the note is misleading.
- `crates/app/tests/real_tip_contour.rs`: the boss fillet pins now use a face selection, not `SrcRef::Entity`. Thus `the_same_contour_pushed_into_the_floor_still_convicts` no longer covers the whole-model path. Think about one whole-model twin of that pin.
- The two new test files `crates/app/tests/contour_whole_step.rs` and `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole.rs` have no `Gate map:` line (see #2361).
- The PR body "Tests" list does not name the two pins added for the first review (`counterbore_changing_before_first_cut_level_keeps_lower_bore`, `earlier_blind_hole_stop_does_not_hide_later_counterbore_change`).
- `contour.rs` is 514 lines and `generate.rs` grew. #2502 tracks the split. Not a blocker.

## What passed

- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. Each index is in range: `remaining` is not empty at line 246, `k < limit` in `first_split`, and `j >= 1` in the `Some(j)` arm.
- The band loop ends: each pass breaks, returns an error, or makes `remaining` shorter. The fallback runs one time.
- Top Z law (#2004/#2013): the floor search never adds a level at Top Z or at a band ceiling.
- Stopped-hole levels: the sorted, distinct hole stops before the outer stop are all checked, index zero included. An earlier blind-hole stop does not hide a later counterbore change.
- An unreadable plane or an unmachinable lower region refuses by name, with the partial path as a ghost.
- The motion pins assert positions and lap lengths, and they run `verify` with the model for clearance. The app pins assert the plate outline, the deepest Z, the tab windows and a clean post.
- Test placement is correct. The decision file is present. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #2436`. No golden and no snapshot PNG changed.

Takeover fix for the blocker in comment 6976858577. New head: `ceac40dd977f9b5fccae5ed31080b2629a501cca`.

## Finding and fix

- Finding: in `contour_whole.rs`, the arm `Some(0) if band_idx == 0` re-sliced the region and emitted nothing from the first band. A ring with a floor pass above the first flat level (#2004 floor search) lost that pass and its notes. The result was `Ok` with no note.
- Fix: the band-0 arm now does the same as the `Some(j)` arm before the re-slice. It trims the ladder at `remaining[0]`. If the trimmed ladder has levels, it forwards the notes, emits the band, records the region in `walked` and sets `ceiling` to the last trimmed level. If the trimmed ladder is empty, the behaviour does not change.
- Changed lines: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs:259-268` (10 lines added). The file has 340 lines.

## Pins

In `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole.rs`:

1. `large_stepdown_keeps_the_upper_island_floor_pass_before_the_plate` (new). It uses `two_islands_part()` with `params(15.0, 0.0, 12.0)`. It asserts one full lap of Island A at Z 10, the plate to Z 0, and a clean `verify` with the model.
2. `counterbore_changing_before_first_cut_level_keeps_lower_bore` (changed). It now also asserts one full lap of the upper bore (extent 12) at Z 10.

The file now has its `Gate map:` line.

## Proof that each pin fails without the fix

I ran the two pins on `c6b66a532` (tests added, fix not applied):

- `counterbore_changing_before_first_cut_level_keeps_lower_bore`: FAILED, `Z 10: expected one complete bore lap, got 0`.
- `large_stepdown_keeps_the_upper_island_floor_pass_before_the_plate`: FAILED, `expected one lap around Island A at Z 10, got -0.000`.

With the fix, all 7 tests of `contour_whole` pass. The `verify` checks with the model show no gouge.

## Gate

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: green, 186 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings`: green.

## Not done

- The other findings of comment 6976858577 stay open. This commit does not change them.
- The PR stays a draft. It needs a new review of this commit.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ceac40dd977f9b5fccae5ed31080b2629a501cca -->
**Verdict: blockers**

Safety-floor re-review (Opus, read only) of `ceac40dd9` against the earlier review of `c6b66a532` (comment 6976858577).

## Range checks

- `c6b66a532..ceac40dd9` is one commit (`ceac40dd9`). It changes 2 files, 44 lines added.
- `--stat` and `--ignore-cr-at-eol --stat` are the same. The line ends did not change.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main ceac40dd9` is clean.

## The new band-0 arm (`contour_whole.rs:258-272`)

It applies the same law as the `Some(j)` arm. It trims the ladder at `remaining[0]`, forwards the ring notes with `continues = true`, emits the trimmed band, pushes the region to `walked` and sets `ceiling` to the lowest trimmed level. The two differences are correct:

- An empty trimmed ladder does not refuse. It keeps the old fallback. This is correct, because a ring with no level above the first flat level has nothing to cut there.
- `remaining` is not shortened, because `j = 0`.

The fix changes nothing in the `Some(j)` arm (j > 0), in the `None` arm, or in the refusal arm `Some(0)` for later bands. The guard `band_idx == 0 && !used_fallback` is unchanged.

## Cases traced by hand

1. `two_islands_part()`, `params(15, 0, 12)`, levels Z 3 and Z 0. Band 0 walks Island A at its floor Z 10 only. The trim removes the Island B levels (3 and 0). The re-slice at Z 3 gives the plate outline (Island A is inside it) and Island B. Each ring is cut one time at each level. There is no gouge. Closed.
2. `counterbore_part()`, `params(20, 0, 12)`, levels Z 8 and Z 0. Band 0 walks the upper bore (extent 12) at Z 10. The outer levels are trimmed out. Band 1 walks the outer ring and the lower bore (extent 7) at Z 8 and Z 0. No level is cut two times. Z 10 is on the shoulder, not in it. Closed.
3. Split at index 0 with an empty trimmed ladder (a ring that is not legal at Top Z, so it has no floor). The behaviour is the same as before the fix. The ring notes of band 0 are dropped, as before. The re-slice cuts the outline. No gouge.
4. A lower outline that is larger than the upper one (Island A on the plate). The upper ring is not walked below its floor, because `ladder` refuses it there. The lower outline is walked only at levels at or below `remaining[0]`, and `remaining[0]` is under its top. No gouge. A true overhang (the upper outline is larger) does not split, because the shadow in `material_overhead_of` keeps the upper outline. The fix does not touch that case.
5. Three levels. See the blocker.

## Blocker

1. **A middle outline whose Z range holds no flat level is never cut, and the result is `Ok` with no note.** See `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs:270` and `:301` (the re-slice at `remaining[0]`).
   - Example: base `[-40..40]^2` Z 0..10, middle step `[-25..25]^2` Z 10..20, boss `[-10..10]^2` Z 20..30. Use `params(30, 0, 25)`. The levels are Z 5 and Z 0.
   - Band 0: the boss ring is not legal at Z 5. The floor search gives Z 20 (the same plane law that gives Island A its floor at Z 10). The new arm emits the boss at Z 20 and sets `ceiling = 20`.
   - The re-slice at Z 5 gives the overhead outline of all material above Z 5. That is the base square. The middle step is inside it and is not a ring.
   - Band 1: the base ring is legal at Z 5 and Z 0. It does not stop, so `ladder` makes no floor search. The wall of the middle step (Z 10..20, at x = 25) gets no pass.
   - `forward_band_notes` with `continues = true` drops the note of the outer boss ring. So the path is silently partial. This is the same class of defect as the blocker of comment 6976858577 and of #2436.
   - The same gap is in the `Some(j)` arm. It occurs when an outline starts and ends between the last level of a band and `remaining[j]`, that is, when a step is shorter than the stepdown.
   - This is stock left behind, not a gouge. `main` also leaves this wall, so it is not a regression of `main`. But the PR states that the whole-model contour continues across lower outlines, and this case is a level that is dropped without a note.
   - Recommended fix: before each re-slice, compare the overhead outline just under `ceiling` with the outline at `remaining[0]`. If they differ, slice an intermediate band at the deepest vertex plane between them, and give that band its floor pass. If that is too large for this PR, refuse or add a visible note that names the uncut Z range ("reduce the stepdown"). Add a pin with the three-level part above that asserts one full lap of the middle step at Z 10 (extent 28) and a clean `verify` with the model.

## Pins

- `large_stepdown_keeps_the_upper_island_floor_pass_before_the_plate` measures one lap of Island A at Z 10 (94..102 mm, so not 0 and not 2 laps). It also checks the plate to Z 0 and a clean `verify` with the model. On the old code band 0 emitted nothing, so the lap is 0. This agrees with the failure that the worker gives ("got -0.000").
- `counterbore_changing_before_first_cut_level_keeps_lower_bore` now calls `assert_counterbore_at(&path, 10.0, 12.0)`. That helper checks the envelope of each move at that Z and a full lap length of `8 * extent`. The model `verify` is also in the pin. It fails on the old code with "got 0", as stated.
- The comment in the new pin says `2*pi*3` for the rounded corners. The older pin says `4*3*sqrt(2)`. The two comments disagree. The tolerance covers both values. Cosmetic.

## Code checks

- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new lines. `unwrap_or(ceiling)` is safe. `remaining[0]` is in range, because the loop breaks on an empty `remaining`.
- `contour_whole.rs` has 340 lines. `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole.rs` has 330 lines.
- The `Gate map:` line is now in `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole.rs`.

## Earlier findings (comment 6976858577)

- Blocker, first band drops its floor passes at a split at index 0: **closed**.
- Error class by substring (`contour_whole.rs:78`, `:186`): open, non-blocking.
- `first_split` compares hole counts after the tool offset, so a lower bore smaller than the tool gives a misleading "solid below" note: open, non-blocking.
- `real_tip_contour.rs` no longer covers the whole-model path in `the_same_contour_pushed_into_the_floor_still_convicts`: open, non-blocking.
- `Gate map:` line: closed for `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole.rs`. Open, non-blocking, for `crates/app/tests/contour_whole_step.rs`.
- The PR body "Tests" list does not name the added pins: open, non-blocking. It now also needs `large_stepdown_keeps_the_upper_island_floor_pass_before_the_plate`.
- `contour.rs` is 514 lines (tracked in #2502): open, non-blocking.

## New non-blocking finding

- In the counterbore case, the forwarded note of the upper bore says "levels below skipped (8.000, 0.000)". The lower bore is cut at those levels in the next band. The note is true for that ring, but it can mislead the user. The `Some(j)` arm has the same note.

Fix for review comment 6978919982 is on head 3dd8e343820c1ead96d84f1d259ef1426b321748.

What changed:
- A middle outline that has no flat level in its Z range now gets its own band with a floor pass (option 1). The band loop compares the outline just under the band ceiling with the outline at the next flat level. If the two outlines are different, the loop cuts an intermediate band at that outline.

The part has a base at Z 0..10, a middle step at Z 10..20 and a boss at Z 20..30, with params (30, 0, 25). The test asserts one full lap at Z 10 (extent 28) and a clean `verify`. Without the fix, the test fails with "expected one lap around the middle step at Z 10, got 0.000".

**Verdict: ready**

Read from the diff. Not built.

Safety-floor re-review (Opus, read only) of `ceac40dd9..3dd8e3438` (one commit). The review reads `contour_whole.rs`, the new `contour_whole_slice.rs`, `contour_depth::ladder` (floor search) and the new pin.

## The blocker of comment 6978919982: closed

I traced the three-level part (base Z 0..10 `[-40..40]^2`, middle Z 10..20 `[-25..25]^2`, boss Z 20..30 `[-10..10]^2`, `params(30, 0, 25)`, levels Z 5 and Z 0):

1. Band 0: the boss ring fails at Z 5. The floor search gives Z 20. `emitted` is true. The boss is cut at Z 20 and `ceiling` becomes 20.
2. `next_region(ceiling 20, z_next 5)`: the lower outline (probe Z 5) is the base. The upper outline (probe Z 19.999) is the middle step. The symmetric difference is large, so the function returns the middle step with `mid = true`.
3. Band 1 (mid): `split` is forced to `Some(0)`. `ladder` with `top = 20` finds the middle ring legal at Z 20 and gives the floor Z 10. The trim keeps Z 10 (above Z 5). The middle step gets one lap at Z 10. `ceiling` becomes 10.
4. `next_region(10, 5)`: the outlines at Z 9.999 and Z 5 are both the base. The base band cuts Z 5 and Z 0 (`None` arm).

The pin `middle_step_without_a_flat_level_gets_its_floor_pass` asserts this: one lap at Z 10 with extent 28, the base to Z 0, and a clean `depth_verify`. The `Some(j)` arm now also calls `next_region` with `emitted = true`, so the same gap after a later band is also closed.

## Safety checks of the delta

- **Correct Z and outline.** The floor pass of an intermediate band uses the outline just under `ceiling` (`ceiling - stock_to_leave - 1e-3`). With `ceiling = v + leave` from the floor search, the probe is just under the vertex plane `v`. That is the outline of the step that stands on that plane. `ladder` checks each level with `legal_at` against the full model, so the wider lower outline is not cut into. The floor search gives `v + leave`, which is the band floor with axial stock.
- **No double cut.** The intermediate band emits only trimmed levels strictly above `remaining[0]` and strictly below `ceiling` (`emitted` checks `< ceiling - SAME_LEVEL`). `ladder` searches floors strictly below `top`.
- **Every stop is reported.** The loop ends in one of these ways:
  - The `None` arm cuts all levels and sets `remaining = &[]`.
  - The `Some(0)` refusal, `check_unread`, `area_at` or `emit_band` returns an error.
  - The new check after the loop returns "too many outline changes" when the band limit stops the loop with levels left.
  - An intermediate band with no floor level adds a visible note and continues at the next flat level.
- **No endless loop.** Each intermediate band lowers `ceiling` strictly to a vertex plane. `mid` is set only after an emit. The cap `2*flat + 3*facets + 2` (saturating) is larger than the number of distinct vertex planes plus the flat levels.
- **No panic path.** There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in new non-test code. `remaining[0]` and `remaining[remaining.len() - 1]` are read only while `remaining` is not empty. `unwrap_or(ceiling)` is safe. There is no float index math.
- **Laws.** `contour_whole.rs` has 335 lines. `contour_whole_slice.rs` has 74 lines and a provenance comment. `crates/motion/tests/contour_whole.rs` has 375 lines. The pin is in the crate that owns the code. No snapshot PNG changed. The `Gate map:` line is now in `crates/app/tests/contour_whole_step.rs`. The PR body now names all pins.

## Blockers

None.

## Non-blockers (follow-up candidates)

1. **Spaces in two user messages.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs:259` and `:298`. The `\` line continuation is missing.
